▪️ Knowledge of cloud billing, pricing models, cost allocation, budgeting, and forecasting.

▪️ Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or similar.

▪️ Experience with cloud monitoring, resource utilization, and cost optimization.
▪️ Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.jdHtml:
AWS DevOps Engineer Requirement in Hyderabad, India
Role Description
- This contract AWS DevOps Engineer role is a hybrid position based in Hyderbad, Telangana, India with some work-from-home flexibility.
- The AWS DevOps Engineer will design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code practices, ensuring scalable, secure, and reliable environments for training platforms and internal systems.
- Day-to-day responsibilities include building and managing CI pipelines, automating deployment processes, monitoring system performance, and troubleshooting issues across development, staging, and production environments.
- The role also involves collaborating with software developers, system administrators, and training teams to improve release workflows, optimize resource usage, and support new course and lab environments on AWS.
Qualifications
- Strong Infrastructure as Code (IaC) skills with tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, and experience automating environment provisioning.
- Hands-on Software Development experience in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) to build automation and integration tools.
- Practical Continuous Integration and delivery (CI/CD) experience with platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline.
- Solid System Administration background, including Linux server management, configuration, monitoring, and performance tuning.
- Experience working with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, ECS/EKS) and applying security, reliability, and cost-optimization best practices.
- Proficiency with containers and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and familiarity with observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK stack).
- Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical concepts clearly, and document solutions and processes.
Please reach me at support@getraind.com i

jobs.jdHtml:
🚀 Hiring: DevOps Engineer – Azure | CI/CD | Kubernetes
📍 Location: Bengaluru – Hybrid
🧑‍💻 Experience: 6+ Years
📋 Employment Type: Full-Time
looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer with strong software engineering expertise and hands-on Azure cloud experience to establish and drive DevOps practices across SaaS, web, and custom development platforms. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in CI/CD automation, Azure DevOps, infrastructure provisioning, containerization, monitoring, and software lifecycle management, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable application delivery across enterprise environments.
🔧 Core Expertise Required
Strong hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipeline design, and automated build and deployment workflows.
Expertise in Git, source control management, branching strategies, merging, and code integration.
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices-based architectures.
Strong scripting expertise in PowerShell or other scripting languages.
Experience with Terraform and infrastructure provisioning / automation on Azure.
Knowledge of code quality and security tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, HCL AppScan, and Orca Security.
Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack.
Strong understanding of Linux infrastructure, Agile / SDLC practices, automated testing, and security best practices.
🎯 Key Responsibilities
Establish, lead, and drive DevOps practices across engineering teams and enterprise platforms.
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps for automated builds, testing, and deployments.
Manage source control, branching strategies, code integration, production builds, and server hotfixes.
Automate infrastructure provisioning, IT administration, and deployment processes using Terraform and PowerShell.
Implement code quality, security scanning, and compliance checks within CI/CD workflows.
Support Docker and Kubernetes-based application deployments and troubleshoot hosting environments.
Monitor application performance, infrastructure availability, and SLA compliance using monitoring and logging tools.
Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve complex application issues.
Ensure adherence to enterprise standards, security policies, and DevOps best practices.
Collaborate with IT, business, and engineering stakeholders to deliver scalable and reusable technical solutions.
🤝 What Looking For
6+ years of IT experience with strong DevOps engineering and Azure cloud expertise.
3–5 years of hands-on experience with Azure DevOps build and deployment pipelines.
Experience in cloud architecture, automation, infrastructure provisioning, and application deployment.
Strong knowledge of CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, and scripting.
Experience with security, code review, automated testing, and monitoring tools.
Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
Ability to influence engineering teams, facilitate technical discussions, and communicate technical concepts to business stakeholders.
📨 Interested? Share your resumes to: harish.veerramani@vdartdigital.com
